items.stem: Why is tracing individual spans (prompt build, model call, tool calls) valuable in an LLM app?

options.text: It localises where latency or errors occur within a single request
options.rationale: Correct: span-level traces show which step is slow or failing.

options.text: It reduces the model's parameter count
It guarantees the answer is correct
options.rationale: Tracing measures behaviour; it does not ensure correctness.

options.text: It removes the need for any metrics

items.explanation: Correct: span-level traces show which step is slow or failing.

items.stem: Which TWO signals should an LLM observability setup capture beyond standard app metrics? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Token usage and cost per request
options.rationale: Correct: tokens drive cost and are LLM-specific.

options.text: Output quality signals such as user feedback or judge scores
options.rationale: Correct: quality is a first-class LLM signal, not captured by uptime alone.

options.text: Only CPU temperature of the client device
options.rationale: That is unrelated to LLM behaviour.
Status codes miss quality, cost and drift.

items.explanation: Correct: tokens drive cost and are LLM-specific.
